title: The Next Market Structure
description:
Coinbase Derivatives have reached record US futures volumes with the acquisition of Deribit. Now, we’re on the path toward unified trading.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain #finance

asr.full_text: Liz Martin VO 1.5.2 Thanks, Alec. I'm Liz Martin, VP of markets at Coinbase. Our markets business is the engine that powers trading across Coinbase, including Prime. 2025 was a defining year for markets, not just in terms of growth, but in the breadth and quality of product innovation we delivered. We fundamentally transformed the way clients access trading products, we expanded our ecosystem globally, delivered. We fundamentally transform the way clients access trading products, we expanded our ecosystem globally and we set the stage for even more ambitious launches in 2026. From spot to derivatives and beyond, we continued building a unified trusted destination where institutional and professional traders can confidently execute sophisticated strategies. Now let's start with one of our fastest growing markets, the US futuresures Market, offered by QAIM-based derivatives exchange, or CFTC-regulated exchange. Over the last year, we saw unprecedented growth in the US Futures Market. And this year has already started strong. We've had record daily volumes exceeding $5 billion in January and February, driven by several key milestones. We launched the first US Perpetual Стel in 2015 with about $16,000 million. exceeding $5 billion in January and February, driven by several key milestones. We launched the first U.S. Perpetual Style Futures offering in the U.S. with 24 seven trading in an expanding set of contracts. Perpetual Style Futures are our most actively traded product on Coinbase derivatives. We also introduced our first equity derivative product, giving clients exposure to leading equities in crypto in a single instrument and we saw expanded asset diversification like increased share and our commodities futures including gold and silver our futures business surpassed one billion in open interest underscoring both adoption and liquidity growth and these developments have not only increased retail and institutional adoption they have also set a strong foundation for our next wave of products like more all coin assets more commodities and more perpetual style futures we're also launching coinbase 50 index, which allow users to trade 50 assets in one futures contract. And of course, as Rick mentioned, clients can trade all these futures directly through Coinbase Prime. That it gives you access to true 24 seven trading with infrastructure built for crypto markets integrated into Prime's trading, financing, custody and reporting toolkit. Now let's dive into our international side of our business where we significantly broadened our PERP Futures offering. In the past year, we've added over 100 new assets and we're focused on listing more pre-launch, day one and emerging assets that traders are demanding. Plus, we've expanded our maximum leverage up to 50 times times which deepened liquidity and enabled more advanced trading strategies. We also laid important groundwork for improved capital efficiency including expanding our collateral flexibility across all of our markets and as mentioned in our December product showcase we're working on adding stock perps to the international derivatives offering and I am very excited to share that we'll have an official announcement in the coming weeks with more details on this really exciting launch. So please stay tuned. Next I want to cover one of the most strategic and significant achievements for us in 2025, the acquisition and onboarding of Darebit. Darebit's the world's leading crypto options exchange by volume and open interest. This was a major step in bringing the full spectrum of derivatives trading into our ecosystem. Darabit has brought us deep expertise in crypto options, an area that institutional clients around the globe have been demanding. And the early progress of this integration has been wildly successful. Darabit surpassed $60 billion in open interest last year. And our combined trading volume across Options and Perps on Darabit exceeded $3 trillion. And with this integration, we can now unlock this growing options market for our broader client base, including through Coinbase Prime, a product direction that we're continuing to build towards. And we're also keenly focused on bringing this options trading capability into the US markets, and this is just the beginning. So in 2026 we're building on the momentum of 2025 towards a cohesive, unified Prime trading platform that brings spot, futures, PRPs, equities and options together in a single place. Our focus remains on continued product innovation, operational excellence, deep liquidity and execution quality, and delivering differentiated client outcomes. We intend to continue expanding access to institutional grade products while making the training experience more powerful and more accessible for all of our clients
